newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to act independently on rate policy - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan to act independently on rate policy - BOJ.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will decide its monetary policy taking into account the conditions of the domestic economy, BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Wednesday.

Asked whether the BOJ would follow in the footsteps of the United States should the U.S. raise interest rates in March, Matsushita told a parliamentary committee: "Each country aims to carry out its own monetary policy appropriately. I am not in a position to comment on the policy of the U.S."
"We will conduct our policy taking into account the overall conditions of the domestic economy," Matsushita added.
